title: Technological Innovation
welcome_lead: Technology reshapes work, leisure and ethics. Discuss AI, biotech, and the digital age in French.
meta_desc: French: technological innovation and its social effects.
final_note: Innovation needs a vocabulary to be debated — build yours.

walkthroughs.body_html: L'IA transforme le marche du travail. Balance with: cependant, elle souleve des questions ethiques. Use il convient de for measured tone.
La fracture numerique affects access. Phrases: les inegalites se creusent, il faut garantir l'acces a tous.
Use futur simple: la technologie transformera nos vies. For hypotheses, conditionnel: si nous investissions plus, nous progresserions.
